# resume

- **version** — 2.0.0
- **stack** — node
- **summary** — Tailor a stored résumé to a job description and render it as a themed PDF. The résumé is supplied once and reused, so later runs need only a job URL. Triggers on "/resume", "tailor my resume", "optimize my resume for this job", a bare job posting URL, or any request to adapt a résumé to a specific posting and produce a PDF. Also handles "update my stored resume", "show my stored resume", and "forget my resume". `skills/resume/skills/resume/SKILL.md:3`
- **triggers** — "/resume", "forget my resume", "optimize my resume for this job", "show my stored resume", "tailor my resume", "update my stored resume"

- **Node.js ≥ 22** (see .nvmrc). `skills/resume/README.md:72`
